text:
Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose roughly tenfold between 1950 and 2016, a gain of about 900% (somewhere between 9x and 12x depending on the dataset and base year). This is from my recollection of Maddison Project-style estimates, not a live data check, so the exact multiple could be off. The order of magnitude is the part I'm most confident in.

CONFIDENCE: 55
